headline: Public hearing on variance requests for 5 Morgan Street, 427-431 Amherst Street, and 3 Ayer Road.
summary: The agenda lists three public hearing requests for variances from city zoning rules. One request would allow five duplex buildings at 3 Ayer Road.
items: 5 Morgan Street (Sheet 42 Lot 149), Daniel J. Maffee and Karen C. Maffee, Trustees: variance for minimum land area (9,395 sqft existing, 10,455 sqft required for 3 dwellings) and variance to allow 2 principal structures on one lot; RC Zone, Ward 3

427-429 & 431 Amherst Street (Sheet H Lots 157 & 40), Shiv Shrestha (Owner), Stonefield Engineering and Design (Applicant): variance for distance from a drive-through lane to a residential zoning district (10.6 feet proposed, 30 feet required); GB & RC Zones, Ward 2

3 Ayer Road (Sheet G Lot 12), Ayer Rd, LLC (Owner): use variance to allow five duplex residential buildings in the R18 Zone; variance to allow more than one principal structure per lot (5 duplex buildings proposed); variance for minimum land area (65,925 sq ft existing, 174,240 sq ft required); remove dilapidated buildings and vehicles and redevelop the lot with five duplex residential buildings and site improvements; R18 Zone, Ward 2
Review of upcoming agenda to determine proposals of regional impact
location: 3rd floor auditorium, Nashua City Hall, 229 Main St, Nashua, NH
plain_text:
C i t y  o f  N a s h u a 
Planning Department 
229 Main Street 
Nashua, New Hampshire 03061-2019 
 
 
October 23, 2026 
 
The following is to be published on ROP November 1, 2026 under 
the Seal of the City of Nashua, Public Notice Format 65 MP 51. 
Notice is hereby given that a Public Hearing of the City of Nashua 
Zoning Board of Adjustment will occur on Tuesday, November 10, 
2026, at 6:30 p.m. in the 3 rd floor auditorium at N ashua City 
Hall, 229 Main St, Nashua, NH. Members of the public can submit 
their comments via email to (zb@nashuanh.gov) or by mail (please 
make sure to include your name/address and comments) by 4:00 p.m. 
on November 9, 2026. Letters should be addressed to City of 
Nashua, Planning Department, P.O. Box 2019, Nashua, NH 03061. 
Plans can be viewed online starting November 5 , 2026 , at 
www.nashuanh.gov. 
 
1. Daniel J. Maffee and Karen C.  Maffee, Trustees (Owner & 
Applicant) 5 Morgan Street (Sheet 42 Lot 149) requesting the 
following variances: 1) from Land Use Code Section 190 -16, 
Table 16-3 for minimum land area, 9,395 sqft existing – 
10,455 sqft required for 3 dwellings, and 2) from Land Use 
Code Section 190-17, B for more than 1 principle structure 
on a lot – 2 proposed. RC Zone, Ward 3. 
 
2. Stonefield Engineering and Design (Applicant) Shiv Shrestha 
(Owner) 427-429 & 431 Amherst Street (Sheet H Lots 157 & 40) 
requesting variance from Land Use Code Section 190-41, C.1 
for minimum distance from a drive -through lane to any 
residential zoning district, 10.6 feet proposed – 30 feet 
required, GB & RC Zones, Ward 2. 
 
3. Ayer Rd, LLC (Owner) 3 Ayer Road (Sheet G Lot 12) requesting 
the following:  1) Use variance from Land Use Code Section 
190-15, Table 15 -1 (#6), to allow five duplex residential 
buildings in the R18 Zone, 2) from Land Use Code Section 
190-17 (B), to allow more than one principal structure per 
lot, 1 permitted – 5 duplex buildings proposed; and, 3) from 
Land Use Code Section 190-16, Table 16-3, for minimum land 
area, 65,925 sq. ft exists – 174,240 sq. ft required – all 
requests to remove all dilapidated buildings and vehicles 
and redevelop the lot with five duplex residential buildings 
and associated site improvements.  R18 Zone, Ward 2.
